entities.name: Otto Frederick Rohwedder
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Otto Frederick Rohwedder was an American inventor and engineer who created the first automatic bread-slicing machine for commercial use. It was first used by the Chillicothe Missouri Baking Company.
